subject: Re: D3PM status - follow-on staffing for the insert/delete work
body:
Dmitri, closing out the window and pre-committing the follow-on so we don't lose momentum over the summer.

The Jun 5 comparison landed: 1.4s vs 6.8s per record, 94% vs 91% schema validity, with the length caveat Carmen described. I'm happy to call that a success and you should feel comfortable saying so.

For the insertion/deletion variant: I have Farah Haddad at 65% on d3pm for July 2026 to build the insertion/deletion evaluation - that is agreed with her and it is the plan of record for July. Carmen stays at 30% to supervise the transition-matrix changes; Ondrej is off the project after the 15th.

That's the whole ask - no new compute, we'll reuse the May reservation pattern. Shout now if July doesn't work for you, because I'm telling Farah it's confirmed.

Deshawn
